testChanges.tests/api/mcp-transition.test.ts: Adds a side by side client test and byte comparisons for published initialize, tools, resources and capabilities, using the existing fixture.

testChanges.src/ai-tools/schema-types.test.ts: Compares the opt-in result schema with the compute API and validates the same synthetic results against it.
testChanges.src/ai-tools/sky-events.test.ts: Runs the existing wire schema validation case with the DE440 contract. The flag-off fixture comparisons keep the previous schema.
testChanges.src/ai-tools/clear-time.test.ts: Replays all original Watch IDs as retained ledger entries and checks the same IDs, key order and live DE440 instants after reconciliation.
testChanges.src/ai-tools/watch/watch.test.ts: Adapts the cursor test to the timing procedures. Adds a cross-midnight replay of an existing ID and a persistent ID check for a newly observed event.
testChanges.tests/sky-watch-drive.ts: Adds a database case for the old cursor, neighboring UTC day, retained ID, pending due time and stale ingest rejection.
testChanges.scripts/check-ai-integrations.mjs: Adds both opt-in rewrites and checks the fingerprints of the published runtime and its retained edition inputs.
testChanges.scripts/claims-ledger-lib.mjs: Keeps the pinned published bundle outside the claims scan. Sources still enter the scan, and the package check verifies the bundle digest.
testChanges.tests/api/compute-api-privacy.test.ts: Includes the two new server-only importers in the exact import inventory. The browser boundary guard remains strict.
